alex-cs: Neptune Analytics submitted a request to onboard a custom 13B clinical summarizer into Private (VPC). Requirements: HSM for key management, on-ingest PHI redaction, no outbound logs, and monthly leakage report. They said renewal depends on Q2 go-live.
jules-se: Do we have the model artifact + license and a residency statement? Also need expected qps and latency SLOs.
alex-cs: Customer note: 'forked open-13b, trained on post-op notes (US-only). Cannot persist raw notes outside VPC. Require KMS in customer's account or HSM usage. Redaction recall >=95%.' Uploaded packet: https://files.redwood/neptune/onboard
marta-ml: For evals: propose PHI-leakage sweep, redaction recall/precision on 300 annotated spans, 200 adversarial prompts, and 400 regen checks to estimate hallucination. Will include a small DP-style trace check.
jules-se: Ops constraints: Private+BYOK KMS needs infra + security approvals and SSO mapping. Also confirm latency target - customer asks median <280ms @512 tokens. Any flexibility?
alex-cs: They marked median <280ms as required for clinician UI. They can accept a 5-day canary with telemetry access.
infra-ops: We'll need KMS ARN, VPC CIDR, peering IPs, and an infra security ticket. HSM usage needs budget approval.
ticket-bot: ticket CS-6122 created: Neptune Analytics 13B private onboarding + HSM + PHI evals. https://issues.redwood/CS-6122
emily-sales: Noted renewal risk. I'll coordinate contract team for a narrow SLA amendment tied to canary signoff.
marta-ml: I'll start assembling eval vectors and post a short sample here before the kickoff.
jules-se: Can we schedule kickoff Thu 11am PT? Need infra, ML, and SE.
alex-cs: Thu 11am PT works for customer. Priority: HIGH 80; slide >4 weeks risks renewal. Let's have canary plan and eval checklist by Wed EOD. Thanks team.
